premise: An old cultivator, 148 years old, stuck at the peak of Foundation Establishment. My lifespan of 150 years is almost spent: I break through to Core Formation or I die.

bible.title: The Flickering Jade: A Cultivator's Last Stand
bible.tone: Desperate, resolute, and filled with the cold beauty of a dying flame
bible.era: Ancient Xianxia Era: spirit talismans, flying swords, and Qi-powered formations

extraordinary.reach: Cultivators refine Qi to transcend mortality, manipulate elements, and fly through the heavens.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.description: The dominant inhabitants of the mortal plains, many of whom seek the Dao to escape the cycle of reincarnation.
peoples.culture: A society deeply structured by sect hierarchies and ancestral respect.

creatures.name: Rank 3 Poison-Spitting Python
creatures.description: A massive serpent whose venom can melt spirit shields and whose scales are as tough as iron.
creatures.worth: Venom glands for poison cultivation; scales for high-grade armour.

rungs.name: Qi Condensation
rungs.description: Drawing Qi into the body to cleanse the meridians.

rungs.name: Foundation Establishment
rungs.description: Liquefying Qi into a spiritual sea to build the foundation of immortality.

rungs.name: Core Formation
rungs.description: Condensing the liquid spiritual sea into a golden core, gaining true longevity.

rungs.name: Nascent Soul
rungs.description: Nurturing a spiritual infant within the core, allowing the soul to survive outside the body.

travel.description: Cultivators travel by foot, spirit carriage, or flying sword. News is carried by messenger birds or spiritual jade slips.

medicine.healing: Medicinal pills and spiritual herbs accelerate cellular repair and mend shattered meridians.

laws.text: Disciples and elders must not slay one another within the sect grounds upon pain of soul extraction.

rules.text: A cultivator's lifespan is bound to their realm; failing to break through before it expires leads to absolute mortality.
Condensing a Golden Core requires compressing one's spiritual liquid into a solid core, a process highly lethal without protective pills.
An aging body's meridians become brittle, exponentially increasing the pain and danger of Qi circulation during breakthrough attempts.
Cultivators of the Foundation Establishment realm and above can traverse vast distances on flying swords, bypassing earthly terrain.

mysteries.question: Where does the legendary Dragon-Blood Grass grow in the Black Abyss?
mysteries.answer: The Dragon-Blood Grass grows in a geothermal cavern beneath the Whispering Falls, directly guarded by a slumbering Rank 3 Poison-Spitting Python.
clues: A faded map fragment found in the sect's outer library mentions 'heat rising from the abyss wetness'.
Alchemist Song notes that the beast's venom has scorched the earth near the falls.

player.name: Han Feng
player.description: An ancient cultivator with a heavily lined face, a long grey beard, and eyes reflecting decades of patience and growing desperation.
player.appearance: Thin, frail-looking frame concealed by loose, faded grey robes. Long, snow-white hair tied in a simple wooden topknot.

skills.name: Qi Refinement
skills.notes: Decades of stagnation have made your control over your existing Qi exceptionally precise.

skills.name: Sword Cultivation
skills.notes: Your swordsmanship is refined, though hindered by a physical body that tires quickly.

skills.name: Herbology
skills.notes: Familiarity with common spiritual herbs from years of searching for a cure.

traits.name: Brittle Meridians
traits.description: Your spiritual pathways are stiff and aged, making heavy Qi circulation painful and dangerous.

traits.name: Tempered Will
traits.description: A century and a half of struggle has made your mind immune to ordinary illusions and spiritual intimidation.

powers.name: Foundation Qi Manipulation
powers.description: You can manifest your liquid spiritual energy to form defensive shields, project blade beams, or glide short distances.
limits: Limited by your pool of spiritual energy.
Overexertion causes physical fatigue and strain on your meridians.

costs.text: Strains your physical body if used continuously for more than a few minutes.

techniques.name: Misty Cloud Sword Stance
techniques.effect: Creates deceptive phantoms of your blade to confuse the opponent's spiritual sense.

wants: Break through to Core Formation or I die.

items.name: Worn Flying Sword
items.description: A steel sword with a slightly dulled edge, but well-maintained and loyal to your spiritual signature.

items.name: Low-grade Qi-Gathering Pill
items.description: A bitter pill that helps replenish lost spiritual energy over several hours.

resources.title: Elder of the Misty Cloud Sect

backstory.text: You joined the Misty Cloud Sect as a young man with average talent.
You reached the peak of Foundation Establishment eighty years ago, but the barrier to Core Formation remained completely impenetrable.
As your lifespan dwindles to its absolute limit, you have retreated to Spirit-Severing Peak to make one final, desperate struggle for immortality.

sect-master.name: Sect Master Liu
sect-master.description: A severe-looking man dressed in pristine white robes. He was once your junior, but achieved Core Formation seventy years ago.
sect-master.appearance: Sharp eyes, high cheekbones, dark hair pinned back by a jade hairpin, and an aura of constant authority.

wants: Preserve the Misty Cloud Sect's lineage.

agenda.goal: Refuses to waste the sect's remaining breakthrough pills on an aging elder with low potential.
agenda.method: Direct Han to dangerous tasks in exchange for resources, hoping he either succeeds against the odds or dies usefully.

disciple-chen.name: Chen Yi
disciple-chen.description: Your only remaining disciple, a young man who remains fiercely loyal despite your lack of prospects.
disciple-chen.appearance: Lean build, slightly patched robes, honest eyes, and calloused hands from hard work.

wants: Help his master find a way to break through.

secrets: He has been secretly skipping his own cultivation resources to buy cheap vitality-preserving herbs for you.

alchemist-song.name: Elder Song
alchemist-song.description: An eccentric alchemist who runs the Pill Hall. He values rare ingredients above sect politics.
alchemist-song.appearance: Slightly stooped, soot-stained fingers, wild grey hair, and a strong scent of burnt sulfur clinging to him.

wants: Refine a perfect grade Core-Assisting Pill.

agenda.goal: Refining a Core-Assisting Pill that could solve Han's bottleneck, but requires a hazardous ingredient.
agenda.method: Offer to make the pill if Han retrieves Dragon-Blood Grass from the Black Abyss Forest.

misty-cloud.description: A struggling cultivation sect trying to preserve its small territory from aggressive neighbours.
misty-cloud.goal: Find a way to produce a new Core Formation cultivator to secure their standing.
misty-cloud.methods: Hoarding resources and searching for ancient ruins.
misty-cloud.strength: A dozen Foundation Establishment elders and a hundred Qi Condensation disciples.
secrets: The sect's spiritual vein is slowly drying up, which will force them to migrate within ten years.

misty-sect.name: Misty Cloud Sect
misty-sect.description: A minor sect built upon a low-grade spiritual vein, hidden amidst shrouded mountain peaks.

spirit-peak.name: Spirit-Severing Peak
spirit-peak.description: A secluded, windswept peak allocated to Elder Han for quiet meditation.

market-town.description: A bustling trading hub at the foot of the mountains where rogues and sect members exchange resources.

Your dantian begins to leak spiritual energy, making cultivation recovery sluggish.
A deathly chill settles in your bones; you can no longer attempt a normal breakthrough.

event-1.title: Lifespan Depletion: The first signs of grey rot touch your spiritual veins, slowing your Qi flow.

positions: Standing in a damp market alley, clutching the jade vial
Standing beside you, staring anxiously at the vial in your hand
props: A cold jade vial containing a low-grade Core-Assisting Pill
scene.ended_on: You hold the cracked jade vial containing the Core-Assisting Pill while Chen Yi watches you anxiously in the crowded market alley.

state.summary: At 148 years old, Outer Elder Han Feng of the Misty Cloud Sect has only two years left to live. Trapped at the peak of Foundation Establishment, he descended Spirit-Severing Peak to Misty River Market and traded his remaining spirit stones for a low-grade Core-Assisting Pill to attempt his final breakthrough.

scenes.narration:
You sit cross-legged on the cold stone platform of Spirit-Severing Peak. The dawn wind is a blade of ice, cutting through your thin, faded grey robes. Your breath comes ragged and shallow, puffing into white mist. Your body feels like brittle dry wood.

Nearby, Chen Yi stands by the cracked stone incense burner, his honest eyes shadowed with a desperate worry. He is only twenty-four, full of youth, yet bound to a master whose flame is flickering out.

Only two years remain of your natural hundred-and-fifty-year lifespan. Without a Core-Assisting Pill, attempting the breakthrough to Core Formation is a ninety percent guarantee of death—your stiff, aged meridians will simply shatter under the pressure. Yet, Sect Master Liu has made his stance clear: the sect will not waste precious resources on an outer elder who has stagnated for eighty years.

Chen Yi steps forward, his hands clenched. "Master," his earnest voice trembles slightly. "The Pill Refinement Hall... Elder Song is preparing a new batch of Core-Assisting Pills this week. There must be a way to secure one, even if the Sect Master refuses us."

You close your eyes, ignoring Chen Yi's desperate plea, and begin to circulate your liquid spiritual energy. You draw the chill of Spirit-Severing Peak into your lungs, forcing your Foundation Qi through pathways that feel like dry, splintering reeds. You attempt to compress the swirling liquid in your dantian, trying to crystallize it into a solid Golden Core by sheer willpower alone.

The moment you press the energy inward, a blinding spasm of agony tears through your chest. Your brittle meridians groaning under the sheer, unyielding pressure, warning you that one more ounce of force will shatter them instantly, turning your body into an empty husk of ash. The ancient laws of cultivation cannot be bypassed by resolve alone; without a Core-Assisting Pill, the bottleneck is an iron wall that will claim your life before you can even touch the threshold. Coughing up a dark, bitter drop of blood onto the frost-rimed stone, you are forced to disperse the gathered Qi before it tears you apart. Chen Yi drops to his knees beside you, his hands trembling as he reaches out to support your shaking frame. "Master! Please, do not throw your life away," he begs, his voice cracking with raw emotion. "The Pill Refinement Hall is our only hope. Or... or we search the Black Abyss Forest ourselves."
scenes.player_action: I sit down, circulate my qi and attempt the breakthrough to Core Formation right now, without the pill.

scenes.narration:
You pull away from Chen Yi's desperate grip, rising with a cold stiffness in your joints, and summon your worn flying sword. Stepping onto the scratched iron blade, you channel your thin, liquid Foundation Qi, ignoring the sharp protest in your meridians. With Chen Yi flying close behind, you glide down from the desolation of Spirit-Severing Peak, cutting through the biting mountain mists.

Below, the bustling streets of Misty River Market emerge along the muddy banks, alive with shouting vendors and the glow of spiritual lanterns. Your feet touch the damp cobblestones. In the crowded alleys, you seek out the rogue alchemical merchants who deal in hoarded treasures. Handing over your last savings of one hundred and twenty spirit stones, you secure a small, cold jade vial. Inside lies a single, dull-red Core-Assisting Pill. It is low in grade, its surface slightly cracked, yet it is a beacon of hope against your impending dissolution. Chen Yi watches you, his face pale, staring at the vial in your hand with a mixture of awe and fear.
scenes.player_action: I go down to Misty River Market and trade my spirit stones for a Core-Assisting Pill.

choices: Return to Spirit-Severing Peak to begin the breakthrough immediately.
Inspect the low-grade pill closely to check its purity.
Ask the shady merchant if he has any better medicine.
